findings.title: Missing Model Router Call Log File

evidence.observation: Model router status reports router_reachable is true but call_log_exists is false

proposed_action.description: Ensure model router creates and persists call_log.jsonl on initialization or routing events

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility and observability into live LLM request logs and routing analytics

findings.title: Direct LLM API Invocation Bypassing Router

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral using raw environment variable keys instead of dispatching via model router

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM requests through the centralized model router endpoint

findings.expected_benefit: Enforces unified model routing, latency tracking, error handling, and quota policies
